bin_hash.description: Hash of the engine artifact AND the frozen config: rescue_shared.frozen_config.combined_bin_hash(artifact_hash, config_hash). Builds made before the config freeze carry only the artifact hash here.

artifact_hash.description: sha256 (first 16 hex) of the engine artifact as compiled, before the version stamp.

config_hash.description: rescue_shared.frozen_config.config_hash of the frozen thresholds, hoax markers and street list (copied to config/ next to this manifest). The field app refuses to start when its own config hashes differently.

entrypoint.description: Command relative to the manifest's folder; reads engine_input JSON on stdin, writes engine_output JSON on stdout.
